# Threat Modeling Tools and Process

Use tooling to accelerate the human analysis, not to replace it.

## Tools

- Microsoft Threat Modeling Tool;
- OWASP Threat Dragon;
- IriusRisk;
- ThreatModeler; and
- CAIRIS.

## Practical Workflow

1. define the scope and trust boundaries;
2. create a data flow diagram;
3. identify threats with STRIDE;
4. create attack trees for high-value assets;
5. score and rank the threats;
6. design mitigations;
7. document security requirements; and
8. update the model as the system evolves.
